title: 没有流水的账户
objective: 用账户和流水的匹配结果识别没有流水的账户。
statement: 找出 accounts 中没有任何 transactions 记录的账户。流水只要有记录就算，金额为 0 也算。依次输出 account_id（账户编号）、account_type（账户类型），每个符合条件的账户一行，行顺序不限。所有账户都有流水时，返回零行。
knowledge: 用 accounts LEFT JOIN transactions 按账户编号配对。一个账户有几笔流水就匹配几行；没有流水的账户也保留一行，流水那一侧补上 NULL。
transactions.id 是不可为空的主键。配对完成后，用 WHERE t.id IS NULL 找没有匹配的账户。t.memo 不能用来判断是否匹配，因为真实流水的备注也可能是 NULL。
ON 决定哪些流水可以配上，WHERE 决定哪些配对后的行留下。ON 中若只允许正金额流水，就会把仅有 0 元流水的账户误列为没有流水。
starterSql: -- 找出从未产生流水的账户。

hints.text: 从完整的账户表出发。要找一笔也没有的账户，哪一列比备注更适合判断有没有配上流水？
LEFT JOIN 的 ON 比较两表的账户编号；配对后用 WHERE 检查右表主键 IS NULL。
SELECT a.id AS account_id, a.account_type FROM accounts AS a LEFT JOIN transactions AS t ON ____ WHERE ____;

referenceSolutions.sql: SELECT a.id AS account_id, a.account_type FROM accounts AS a LEFT JOIN transactions AS t ON t.account_id = a.id WHERE t.id IS NULL;
referenceSolutions.explanation: 左连接保留了没有流水的账户，补出来的流水编号为 NULL。预览里只有账户 7、10、12 没有任何流水编号可匹配。

expectedFailures.sql: SELECT a.id AS account_id, a.account_type FROM accounts AS a JOIN transactions AS t ON t.account_id = a.id WHERE t.id IS NULL;
SELECT a.id AS account_id, a.account_type FROM accounts AS a LEFT JOIN transactions AS t ON t.account_id = a.id AND t.id IS NULL;
SELECT a.id AS account_id, a.account_type FROM accounts AS a LEFT JOIN transactions AS t ON t.account_id = a.id;
SELECT a.id AS account_id, a.account_type FROM accounts AS a LEFT JOIN transactions AS t ON t.account_id = a.id WHERE t.memo IS NULL;
SELECT a.id AS account_id, a.account_type FROM accounts AS a LEFT JOIN transactions AS t ON t.account_id = a.id AND t.amount > 0 WHERE t.id IS NULL;
